meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 调用 Centinela(QA)智能体执行安全审计:系统检查 OWASP Top 10、密钥泄漏、依赖 CVE 与 Solidity 合约,给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED 结论,并输出报告文件。
howto.when: 在发布前、涉及认证/授权或数据处理的重大改动后,或新增依赖等场景触发;也可直接运行 /security-audit。

只审计指定的这几个目录

say.text: 对 src/payments/ 做一次发布前安全审计
say.note: 报告写入 docs/reviews/ 下的日期文件

howto.what_en: Invokes the Centinela (QA) agent to run a deep security audit: OWASP Top 10 checks, secrets scanning, dependency CVE review, and Solidity contract checks, ending with an APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED verdict and a report file.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a release, after significant changes to authentication, authorization, or data handling, or when adding new dependencies; you can also run /security-audit manually.

say_en.note: Audits the whole default src/ directory

say_en.text: Run a pre-release security audit on src/payments/
